Neither Poczta source contains postal-area geometry; 00-940 returned six membership rows and no area was invented from their envelope or administrative context.
GUGiK PRG/address sources are separate administrative/address authorities. Six direct Geoportal/WFS requests timed out, which is availability evidence only and not proof of absence.
No fixed authoritative postcode-area body, digest, CRS, topology, coverage or complete assignment-to-area/non-area reconciliation could be verified.

Poppler rendered the first PDF page, but the local image viewer returned Windows error 206 for both original and shortened paths; exact-body, pdfinfo and extracted-text checks passed and no visual-review claim is made.

A lockfile npm ci in the isolated worktree failed with ENOSPC. Tests reused an existing read-only dependency tree through a temporary junction. The standard typecheck then lacked four workspace symlinks; a temporary tsconfig mapped the six package names to their declared local src/index.ts public entries, and the full graph passed.
No real PL postcode runtime, API map fit, translucent rendering or browser E2E can be exercised without an approved fixed reconciled artifact.
